summary: C1 proposal is approved. The schemaVersion-2 C1 format and bounded schemaVersion-1/missing legacy recognizer preserve fail-closed behavior; ContextFile now projects directly to B1 Run and supports both Change-level and Delivery-level Runs.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Three-way version discriminator prevents malformed schemaVersion-2 C1 records from downgrading to legacy.
ContextFile.inputRef is optional ResultRef and directly maps to B1 Run.inputRef.
Action scope defines changeKey/changeId presence for Change-level and Delivery-level Runs.

checks.name: Proposal contract review
checks.result: Reviewed frozen boundaries, B1 types, C1 persistence contracts, historical Bootstrap compatibility, and lifecycle routing.
